title: Day 3 — AI Se Images Banana: Midjourney & Ideogram Basics
preamble: AI image generation tools جيسا تائين Midjourney ۽ Ideogram توهان کي text کان realistiq, artistic يا unique images بنائڻ ۾ مدد کري ٿا. بس ايک prompt لکڻ آهي، ۽ AI اهو visualize کري ٿو. ايھ designing, marketing, social media ۽ freelancing لاءِ ڀت محفوظ آهي.

sections.label: Concept
sections.content: AI image generation tools جيسا تائين Midjourney ۽ Ideogram توهان کي text کان realistiq, artistic يا unique images بنائڻ ۾ مدد کري ٿا. بس ايک prompt لکڻ آهي، ۽ AI اهو visualize کري ٿو. ايھ designing, marketing, social media ۽ freelancing لاءِ ڀت محفوظ آهي.

sections.label: Example
sections.content:
Midjourney ۾ image بنائڻ لاءِ:
1. Discord server join ڪريو (midjourney.com)
2. `/imagine prompt: a cyberpunk city at night, neon lights, futuristic, highly detailed` لکڻ آهي
3. AI 4 images generate کري ٿي، پهر توهان "Upscale" يا "Variation" کري سگهڻ آهيون.

sections.label: Practice
sections.content:
اپڻ Discord ۾ Midjourney join ڪريو، ۽ ايھ prompt try ڪريو:
`/imagine prompt: a cute corgi dog wearing a chef hat, cooking in a kitchen, cartoon style`

sections.label: Mini Project
sections.content:
ايک 3-image series بنائيو:
1. "A futuristic office in 2050"
2. "A cozy library with floating books"
3. "A dragon flying over a medieval castle"
سڀ کي ايک-ساتھ save ڪري ايک folder ۾ رکيو.
